description.zh: 加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).

descriptions.zh:
> - 如果您的域名处于非法状态或域名对应账户欠费，您将无法正常调用该接口启用加速域名。
>- 单次配置的域名数量不超过50个。
>- 单用户调用频率：30次/秒。
descriptions.en:
> - You cannot call this operation to enable an accelerated domain name if the domain name is invalid or the associated account has an overdue payment.
>
> - A maximum of 50 domain names can be enabled in a single request.
>
> - The call frequency for a single user is limited to 30 calls per second.
